question: Which of the following is NOT a product made from crude oil?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anthracite.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Constituents of petroleum are derived from crude oil.
 
• Crude oil is processed in a refinery where different types of products are obtained from it.
 
• Gasoline(Petrol) is a product that is majorly obtained from petroleum.
 
• **Anthracite is the highest rank of coal.**
 
• **It is a hard, brittle, and black lustrous coal, often referred to as hard coal.**
 
 
• **Hence Anthracite is NOT a product made from crude oil.**
 
 
 
• Many types of fuels and other products are obtained from it.​
